command:
set -e
base=/mnt/nvme0n1-1/Configs/mise-runtime-acceptance-20261123
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
df -k /overlay /mnt/nvme0n1-1
cmp "$base/M4/compat/original-mise.sh" /lib/functions/mise.sh
sha256sum /lib/functions/mise.sh
cd "$base/M4/compat"
timeout -k 2 15 /usr/sbin/mise-istore exec -- node --version
printf 'node --version\n' | timeout -k 2 15 /usr/sbin/mise-exec
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:9000/healthz
printf '\n'
grep -E '  /usr/sbin/(iStoreEnhance|agentflow)$|  /lib/functions/mise.sh$' "$base/baseline/protected.sha256" | sha256sum -c -
sha256sum /etc/config/istoreenhance /etc/config/agentflow
pidof iStoreEnhance agentflow
ls -la "$base/Runtime-live/environments" "$base/Runtime-live/work"
test ! -e "$base/Runtime-live/.lock"
opkg list-installed | grep -E '^(mise|mise-runtime|luci-app-mise|app-meta-mise|ks-cli) '
